title: Designing a Nearly Optimal Quantum Algorithm for Linear Differential Equations via Lindbladians
formerTitle: Design nearly optimal quantum algorithm for linear differential equations via Lindbladians
authors: Zhong-Xia Shang, **Naixu Guo**, Dong An, Qi Zhao
summary: Linear differential equations encoded in Lindbladian dynamics, with query complexity close to the known lower bound under a plausible input model.
